dna.opening: a dated 2000s guesthouse page in a tilted glass browser on navy, beige tiles, a blinking marquee and "book by email", under the hook "Is your website losing you bookings?"
dna.bigMoment: the old page breaks into a grid of 3D tiles that flip over in a diagonal wave with lime edge glints, revealing the new dawn-ridge guesthouse site, then a calendar layer pops out of a phone and books two nights in two taps
dna.ground: cinematic navy with a blue perspective floor grid, a drifting dot field, a soft blue spot, lime and blue light leaks on the cuts, one coral problem colour
dna.music: warm minimal electronic with a soft pluck, a held breath, a bright lift on the tile wave and a gentle resolve, about 96 BPM
